members.title: 36 children’s bodies recovered in 8 months: ASK
members.lead: Ain o Salish Kendra (ASK) has expressed deep concern over the murder of 13 years old Ishayat Shahriar Opratim after he went missing in Cumilla. In a press release issued on Sunday, ASK pointed to recent incidents involving missing children, killings following rape and other forms of abuse, raising serious concerns over children’s safety.According to ASK monitoring data, 36 children’s bodies were recovered after disappearance between January and August this year, while 254 children died in various incidents during the period. Police Headquarters data shows that 15,717 children were reported missing between January and July. Of them, 13,679 were recovered
